The independent stencil contract measures divergence_j = 7.315873469501451e-05 at 91 nodes over 3.2 m, giving reference pitch h_ref = 3.2 / (91 - 1) = 0.035555555555555556 m.
The frozen MAST acceptance cohort uses the stored 65-point axes at stride 2, giving 33 by 33 nodes and spacings 0.060624998062849045 m and 0.125 m; the conservative production pitch is h = 0.125 m.
For second-order truncation, T(h) = T(h_ref) * (h / h_ref)^2.
